title: PARAM-1 BharatGen 2.9B Model
findings: PARAM-1 demonstrates superior performance on culturally grounded tasks specific to India. On the SANSKRITI benchmark, which tests knowledge of Indian festivals, cuisine, and rituals, PARAM-1 outperformed SARVAM-1. Qualitative analysis also showed its ability to generate culturally nuanced responses regarding religious festivals like Diwali. This suggests that the model's design, which prioritizes Indian linguistic and cultural data, results in a better-aligned LLM for these contexts.
